introHtml: Neoprene gives your custom buttons, stickers, and patches a soft, durable edge that standard paper or vinyl can't match. Ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, or employee morale kits, neoprene patches resist moisture and wear while offering a comfortable, flexible feel. Choose from sew-on or iron-on backing for easy application to bags, uniforms, or hats. Bulk orders keep your cost per unit low, making neoprene a practical choice for ongoing brand visibility.
